declare

 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_life_span number(4,0);
 temp_base_dats date;
 cur_exp_date date;
 temp_max_dats date;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 cursor c1 is
 select life_span, life_span_ind,
 component_attributes.proc_date base_dats
 from valid_product_attributes, component_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 component_attributes.product_code =:product_code and
 life_span_ind is not null and
 life_span is not null and
 valid_product_attributes.attrib_group =
 component_attributes.attrib_group and
 valid_product_attributes.attrib_code =
 component_attributes.attrib_code and
 --HCL valid_product_attributes.product_code
 valid_product_attributes.product_type =(SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code=
 SUBSTR(component_attributes.product_code ,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme) and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
begin
 if :GLOBAL.product_type not in ('RPL','RPFF') and
 :GLOBAL.product_type not like 'DU%'
 then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- check if there are attributes associated to the
 -- component that have expirations associated to them
 --
 -- prev_exp_date has the base value;
 -- cur_exp_date has the value which is the current
 -- value after the calculation; If prev_exp_date >
 -- cur_exp_date, then prev_exp_date made equal to
 -- temp_expiry_dats (simple logic for calculation of
 -- minima
 --
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'N';
 begin
 prev_exp_date := add_months(sysdate,12*100);
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'Y';
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c1_rec.base_dats)+
 (to_number(c1_rec.life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c1_rec.base_dats),
 12*c1_rec.life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;

PROCEDURE calculate_expiry_date1 IS

 component_attributes.proc_date base_dats

 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 component_attributes.product_code =:ctrl_blk_1.product_code and

 life_span is not null and
 valid_product_attributes.attrib_group = component_attributes.attrib_group and
 valid_product_attributes.attrib_code = component_attributes.attrib_code and
 --HCL valid_product_attributes.product_code
 valid_product_attributes.product_type =(SELECT product_type

 WHERE product_code = substr(component_attributes.product_code ,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme) and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- check if there are attributes associated to the
 -- component that have expirations associated to them
 --
 -- prev_exp_date has the base value;
 -- cur_exp_date has the value which is the current
 -- value after the calculation; If prev_exp_date >
 -- cur_exp_date, then prev_exp_date made equal to
 -- temp_expiry_dats (simple logic for calculation of
 -- minima
 --
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'N';
 begin
 prev_exp_date := add_months(sysdate,12*100);
 :ctrl_blk_1.life_span_ind := 'Y';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'Y';
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c1_rec.base_dats)+(to_number(c1_rec.life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));

 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c1_rec.base_dats), 12*c1_rec.life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 cur_exp_date := c1_rec.base_dats +(c1_rec.life_span/24);
 end if;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.life_span_ind := c1_rec.life_span_ind;
 end if;
 --HCLC Code128 -- to default the value of exp_date_scan time component
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Check the expiry date/time based on the product
 --

 into temp_life_span, temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_products 
 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and

 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then

 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 begin
 select bleed_start_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting bleed time');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 cur_exp_date := temp_bleed_start_time + (temp_life_span/24); 
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.life_span_ind := temp_life_span_ind; 
 end if;
 :s_actual_expiry_date := prev_exp_date;
-- end if; /* HCL end if for RPL/RPFF */
 exception

 then

END;

 ( SELECT product_type FROM valid_products WHERE

/* AND not exists

 AND attrib_code in

 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(temp_d_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 ) */


 --Cursor for overriding attributes

 CURSOR c2 IS 
 SELECT va.attrib_code, va.life_span, va.life_span_ind, ca.proc_date base_dats
 FROM valid_product_attributes va, component_attributes ca
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND ca.product_code = p_prod_code
 AND life_span_ind is not null 
 AND life_span is not null 
 AND va.attrib_group = ca.attrib_group 
 AND va.attrib_code = ca.attrib_code 
 AND va.product_type =
 ( SELECT product_type FROM valid_products WHERE 
 product_code = substr(ca.product_code ,1,5) 
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I') 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) 
 AND exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = ca.attrib_code
 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND product_code = p_prod_code
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 );
 

BEGIN
 
--Get the Lifespan indicator

Begin
 select life_span,life_span_ind into szLifeSpan,szLifeSpanInd from valid_products where
 product_code=substr(p_prod_code,1,5) and product_type=:global.product_type and 
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
Exception when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
End;

-- Get the collection date
begin
 select bleed_start_time into szCollDate from units where unit_id=:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
exception when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 If szLifeSpanInd='D' then 
 szTempDate:=trunc(szCollDate)+szLifeSpan;
 szExpDate:=to_date(to_char(szTempDate,'mm-dd-yyyy')|| '23:59','mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi');
 End If;

 If szLifeSpanInd='Y' then 
 szTempDate:=add_months(trunc(szCollDate),12*szLifeSpan);
 szExpDate:=to_date(to_char(szTempDate,'mm-dd-yyyy')|| '23:59','mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi');
 End If;

 If szLifeSpanInd='H' then
 szTempDate:=szCollDate+(szLifeSpan/24);
 szExpDate:=szTempDate;
 End If; 

 --message('szExpDate='||to_char(szExpDate,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;

--If there is no component attributes, then 
select count(*) into nCount from component_attributes where unit_id=p_unit_id and
product_code=p_prod_code ;

IF nCount = 0 then 
 --take the above exp date
 null;
ELSE

 --Calculate the non overriding attributes in this cursor

 prev_exp_date1 := add_months(sysdate,12*100); --initializing a hypothetical value

 For c1_rec in c1 loop

 --Make sure the attributes are not the result of any overriding attributes (EX: B02,C2-both are defined in the overriding to +02, but +02 is not defined as a soucr attribute in the ovr table) 

 select nvl(count(*),0) into bCount from valid_exp_date_ovr where ovr_attrib_code =c1_rec.attrib_code and
 attrib_code in (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND product_code = substr(p_prod_code,1,5)
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 
 If bCount =0 then

 temp_span:=c1_rec.life_span;
 temp_span_ind:=c1_rec.life_span_ind;


 if temp_span_ind = 'D' then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c1_rec.base_dats)+(to_number(temp_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;

 if temp_span_ind = 'Y' then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c1_rec.base_dats), 12*to_number(temp_span));
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;

 if temp_span_ind = 'H' then
 cur_exp_date := c1_rec.base_dats +(to_number(temp_span)/24);
 end if;
 if prev_exp_date1 > cur_exp_date then
 prev_exp_date1 := cur_exp_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.life_span_ind := temp_span_ind;
 end if;
 End If;
 
 End loop;


 --Now, calculate the overriding cattributes in this cursor

 --message('prev_exp_date1='||to_char(prev_exp_date1,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;

 cur_exp_date:=null;
 prev_exp_date2 := add_months(sysdate,12*100);

 For c2_rec in c2 loop

 --Check if the attribute is in the override table

 begin
 
 select ovr_attrib_code into szOvrCode from valid_exp_date_ovr where attrib_code=c2_rec.attrib_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception when others then 
 handle_error;
 end; 

 
 begin
 temp_span_ind:=null;
 temp_span:=null;

 select nvl(life_span,c2_rec.life_span),nvl(life_span_ind,c2_rec.life_span_ind) into 
 temp_span, temp_span_ind from valid_product_attributes vpa, component_attributes ca where
 unit_id=p_unit_id and ca.product_code=substr(p_prod_code,1,5) and ca.attrib_code=szOvrCode and
 ca.attrib_code=vpa.attrib_code and
 ca.attrib_group=vpa.attrib_group and rownum=1 and sysdate between vpa.eff_date and nvl(vpa.term_date,sysdate+1);

 if temp_span_ind = 'D' then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c2_rec.base_dats)+(to_number(temp_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;

 if temp_span_ind = 'Y' then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c2_rec.base_dats), 12*to_number(temp_span));
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 
 if temp_span_ind = 'H' then
 cur_exp_date := c2_rec.base_dats +(to_number(temp_span)/24);
 end if;

 if prev_exp_date2 > cur_exp_date then
 prev_exp_date2:= cur_exp_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.life_span_ind := temp_span_ind;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 null;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 end;

 End Loop;

 -- select the LEAST of all the dates

 --message('prev_exp_date2='||to_char(prev_exp_date2,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;

 select LEAST(szExpDate,prev_exp_date2,prev_exp_date1) into final_exp_date from dual;


 End If;
 return (final_exp_date);
END;

PROCEDURE AG_update_antigens_array IS
 TYPE test_rec IS RECORD(
 test_id VARCHAR2(30),
 test_result VARCHAR2(1),
 config_res VARCHAR2(1)
 );
 
 content_string VARCHAR2(25);
 pkg_status VARCHAR2(5);
 
 CMV_rec test_rec;
 HBS_rec test_rec;
 IGA_rec test_rec;
 PARVO_rec test_rec;
 
 FUNCTION cmv_test_id RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 lv_test_id VARCHAR2(20);
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUBSTR(test_ids, INSTR(test_ids, ',')+1 )
 INTO lv_test_id
 FROM valid_antigen_ds_det
 WHERE pos_no = 16
 AND ds_id= 'DS012';
 RETURN lv_test_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END cmv_test_id; 
 
 FUNCTION get_RC003_test_info(pResultValue IN NUMBER) 
 RETURN test_rec 
 IS
 lv_rec test_rec;
 BEGIN
 lv_rec.test_id := NULL;
 lv_rec.config_res := NULL; 
 SELECT test_ids, result_combination
 INTO lv_rec.test_id, lv_rec.config_res
 FROM valid_antigens_rcvs_det
 WHERE rc_id= 'RC003'
 AND result_value = pResultValue; 
 
 RETURN lv_rec;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN lv_rec;
 END get_RC003_test_info; 
BEGIN
 -- Certain tests are not pouplated in the antigen block but still need to be sent
 -- as part of antigen tests.
 -- Eg: HbS (96), CMV(16), IgA (98), PARVO (97) 
 -- CMV and PARVO are part of MAN group.
 -- HbS and IgA are not configured in valid_antigen_config_Det table, so they
 -- do not go to ag_donor_Tests_det table.

 -- CMV
 CMV_rec.test_id := NVL(cmv_test_id, 'CMV');
 AG_get_test_result (
 unit_id_in => :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 test_id_in => CMV_rec.test_id,
 result_out => CMV_rec.test_result); 
 -- Add to antigen array only if + or - result. 
 IF CMV_rec.test_result IS NOT NULL THEN
 antigen_array.g_antigen_list(CMV_rec.test_id) := CMV_rec.test_result;
 END IF;
 
 -- HbS
 HBS_rec := get_RC003_test_info(96); -- Gets test_id and config_res
 AG_get_test_result (
 unit_id_in => :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 test_id_in => HBS_rec.test_id,
 result_out => HBS_rec.test_result); 
 -- Add to antigen array only if result also matches. 
 IF HBS_rec.test_result IS NOT NULL AND HBS_rec.test_result = HBS_rec.config_res 
 THEN
 antigen_array.g_antigen_list(HBS_rec.test_id) := HBS_rec.test_result;
 END IF; 
 
 
 -- IgA
 IGA_rec := get_RC003_test_info(97); -- Gets test_id and config_res
 AG_get_test_result (
 unit_id_in => :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 test_id_in => IGA_rec.test_id,
 result_out => IGA_rec.test_result); 
 -- Add to antigen array only if result also matches. 
 IF IGA_rec.test_result IS NOT NULL AND IGA_rec.test_result = IGA_rec.config_res 
 THEN
 antigen_array.g_antigen_list(IGA_rec.test_id) := IGA_rec.test_result;
 END IF; 
 
 
 -- PARVO
 PARVO_rec := get_RC003_test_info(98); -- Gets test_id and config_res
 AG_get_test_result (
 unit_id_in => :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 test_id_in => PARVO_rec.test_id,
 result_out => PARVO_rec.test_result); 
 -- Add to antigen array only if result also matches. 
 IF PARVO_rec.test_result IS NOT NULL AND PARVO_rec.test_result = PARVO_rec.config_res 
 THEN
 antigen_array.g_antigen_list(PARVO_rec.test_id) := PARVO_rec.test_result;
 END IF; 
 
 IF :global.antigen_sel = 'Y' THEN
 ag_lbl.get_data_content_string(antigen_array.g_antigen_list, content_string, pkg_status);

 IF pkg_status = 'OK' THEN
 :ctrl_blk_antgn.print_string := content_string;
 ELSE
 message('error in finding the antigen string');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 
END AG_update_antigens_array;

 utrs

 utrs

 master_codes
